message.reasoning_content:
The kernel applies a view-dependent permutation (slot depends on anchors per view). The contract requires ONE shared transform across both views. The initial probe's per-view error was 0 but with different signs per view — that's the trap: the probe checked per-view independently, not shared. Need to test E with shared transform.

Analyze: view 0 has zero columns 2,3; view 1 has zero columns 0,3. Kernel maps column c -> slot by rank of |anchor| within view. Permutation p_v differs potentially per view. If p_0 != p_1, no shared transform exists, but because zero columns make some permutations equivalent within a view, maybe a shared one still fits. Need to check numerically.

Record claim, run probe computing E with shared (p,s).
